_note: Maps business categories onto SHRUG industrial classification codes. This is a judgement about which published industry a business competes in, so every entry records its reasoning and is auditable against the description table. A category that has no honest match is deliberately absent rather than approximated.

_unmapped.poultry: SHRIC has no livestock-rearing code. The nearest is 5 'Processing of meat', which is a different business: a backyard poultry unit rears birds and sells eggs and live birds, it does not run a meat-processing establishment. Real competitors are other backyard units, which the Economic Census does not register as establishments at all. Mapping poultry to code 5 would answer a different question than the one asked, so it is left unmapped and competitors.py falls back to the observed OSM floor with its 'no_ec13_row' advisory.

dairy.why: Code 7 is literally 'Dairy'. Exact match, no interpretation needed.

flour_mill.why: Code 8 is 'Grain milling and grain products' — precisely what an atta chakki does. Exact match.

kirana.why: 47 'Retail of food, beverages, and tobacco' plus 49 'Retail in non-specialized stores'. A kirana is by definition non-specialized food retail. 48 'Retail in specialized stores' is excluded: a specialist shop is not a kirana and including it would inflate the competitor count.

tailoring.why: 14 'Manufacturing of clothing' is the core of a made-to-order village tailor. 50 'Repair of personal goods, finishing of textiles, preparation of textile fiber' covers the alteration and repair work that makes up the rest of the trade.
